_doc: Owned by AI-C. 8 'How to play' cards for B's Help screen. Shape: {cards:[{id,title(<=28),lines:[line1,line2]}]}, each line <=110 chars. Show in order. Tone: cozy, dry, no jargon.

cards.title: Finding things
lines: Things get left behind: under seats, on sills, behind curtains. Tap a glowing spot to pick one up.
Each stop brings fresh finds. Nothing is ever lost for good, just waiting.

cards.title: The bench and five tools
lines: Set an item on the bench, then pick a tool: Magnifier, Lamp, Ear, Nose or Brush.
Each tool shows one kind of clue: marks, colour, sound, smell, wear. Try them all.

cards.title: Asking questions
lines: When a claimant reaches the counter, ask up to three questions. Mood changes how they answer.
Write nothing down: the ledger remembers every answer for you.

cards.title: Spotting imposters
lines: Now and then someone claims an item that is not theirs. Exactly one detail will be wrong.
Check the clues against what they said. Refusing a fibber earns a small bonus.

cards.title: Tokens and reputation
lines: Every happy handover pays tokens. Spend them in the shop whenever you like.
Reputation grows with each good return and opens new tiers. It never goes down.

cards.title: New cars
lines: As your reputation climbs, more cars of the Zero Line open to you: sleeper, observation, luggage.
Each has its own seats, quirks and things people forget.

cards.title: Porters and the shop
lines: Porters carry finds to the shelf for you at every stop. A wider bench holds more at once.
Lamp oil, a UV lamp and a few cosy extras are in there too.

cards.title: The nightly case
lines: Once a day, one special case turns up: a single item, a single owner, one chance to solve it.
Come back tomorrow for the next. Streaks are only for fun.

cards.title: The train map
lines: Tap the little train in the corner to see every car at a glance, lit where you are.
Tap a car, then Go there. Locked cars open as your reputation grows.
